Subject: Acme Exec Workshop — venue brief & pre-read pack

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for lining up the July 20 workshop for Acme's executive team. Attached is our initial draft agenda (Acme_exec_workshop_draft_agenda_v2.pdf) and a venue contact who will handle badges and A/V onsite. Two asks from our side to help finalize logistics:

1) Can you confirm the final run of show (30/45/60 min breakouts) and who will present each segment?
2) We'd like a pre-read packet shared with execs by July 15 — can you confirm owners for the pre-read sections and a single place to upload the materials?

Jordan (cc'd) will be the venue lead; he can confirm room layout options.

Appreciate a rough assignment by Friday so we can circulate internally.

Best,
Emma Brooks
Director, Corporate Programs
Acme Corp

Emma — thanks for the agenda and the asks. Confirming we can hit the July 15 pre-read deadline. Proposed next steps from our side:

- I'll draft a concise \"what to expect\" one-page that frames goals and success metrics for the execs (owner: neha_kapoor).
- Marissa, can you own presenter assignments and collate slide decks into a single pre-read ZIP?
- Laura, can you confirm breakout facilitator names and desired breakout lengths?
- Recommend using the Google Drive folder you suggested for uploads; we'll publish a single ZIP (Pre-read-pack.zip) and a one-page index.

I'll also propose a finalized run-of-show today with 3 options (tight 3.5h / 4.5h / full day). If we agree on the 4.5h option, I suggest 40 min keynote / 15 min break / two 45 min breakout rounds / lunch / closing panel.

Quick note on AV: we'll ask the venue to stage two confidence monitors for panelists and a single mics routing plan. Jordan, can you confirm available AV kit and whether the riser can support three presenters?

On assignments: please see my draft below — feel free to adjust.

--Neha

Thanks — below is a consolidated presenter/owner list and a link to the Drive folder where I'm assembling the pre-read materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AxaAcmeWorkshopPreRead

Presenter + Pre-read owners (proposed):
- Opening & Goals (10m): Neha Kapoor — one-pager framing goals (owner: neha_kapoor)
- Product Vision Keynote (40m): Marissa Cole — slide deck + 3-page appendix (owner: marissa_cole)
- Case Study: Retail — Laura Bennett & Acme lead (20m): Laura to coordinate case study blurb (owner: laura_bennett)
- Breakouts (2 x 45m): Facilitators: Dev Patel (Scale/ops), Paul Huang (Customer Success — external). Breakout prep doc owner: dev_patel
- Closing Panel (25m): Panel moderator: Marissa; panelists: Neha + Acme execs. Panel questions in pre-read appendix.

Uploads and deadlines:
- Please upload final slides into the Drive folder by Jul 14 COB. I will assemble the ZIP and circulate the pre-read to the Acme invite list on Jul 15 morning.
- I've attached the initial ZIP stub and venue floorplan for Jordan (Pre-read-pack.zip, Venue_floorplan.png).

Jordan — can you confirm that the room can be set up in a hollow-square for breakouts or cabaret for roundtables? Also confirm room A/V and riser specs so we can confirm our staging plan.

Notes: I'll handle slide consolidation and light design polish; if presenters have heavy data slides please flag me early.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Product Marketing — Redwood Inference
